anchoring_u.plus_c1_desc: For this money you get a pack of cigarettes on average. This is a monthly subscription.
anchoring_u.plus_c2_desc: Less than the price of a premium coffee daily. In return, a full month of financial awareness.
anchoring_u.plus_c3_desc: It costs as much as a fast food menu. But this will teach you to save money in a month.
anchoring_u.plus_c4_desc: Less than a large soda at the cinema. But this helps you with your finances throughout the month.
anchoring_u.plus_c5_desc: It costs as much as a newspaper and a sandwich. In return, financial awareness for a month.
anchoring_u.pro_c1_desc: Less than two packs of cigarettes. In return, a month of personalized financial coaching.
anchoring_u.pro_c2_desc: It costs as much as a pizza in a good restaurant. But this develops your financial habits throughout the month.
anchoring_u.pro_c3_desc: For less than the price of two premium coffees, you get a monthly personalized financial analysis.
anchoring_u.pro_c4_desc: It costs as much as a movie ticket with popcorn. But this is a month of exclusive financial advice.
anchoring_u.pro_c5_title: A taxi ride in the city center
anchoring_u.pro_c5_desc: Less than a short taxi ride. In return, a month of professional financial insights.
anchoring_u.pro_c6_title: A cocktail in a good bar
anchoring_u.pro_c6_desc: It costs as much as a cocktail in a cool place. But this teaches you to invest throughout the month.
